te: The hymn that becomes known as "Amazing Grace", previously titled "1 Chronicles 17:16–17, Faith's Review and Expectatio…
dz: 被称作"惊人的恩典"(Amanzing Grace)的赞美诗,之前被取名为"1 Chronicles 17: 16–17, Faith's Reversion and peopleation",最早用于伴随由约翰·牛顿(John Newton)在英国白金汉郡奥尔尼镇所领导的布道.
de: The hymn that becomes known as "Amazing Grace", previously titled "1 Chronicles 17:16–17, Faith's Review and Expectation", is first used to accompany a sermon led by John Newton in the town of Olney, Buckinghamshire, England.

dz: 詹姆斯·库克船长率领第一次远征出海去南极圈以南航行.

dz: 沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯·莫扎特离开 意大利在他在那里的三次旅行中的最后一次之后.

t: 大不列颠议会通过"茶叶法案",旨在通过减少其茶叶税并授予其直接向北美出售茶叶的权利来拯救英国东…
te: The Parliament of Great Britain passes the Tea Act, designed to save the British East India Company by reducing taxes o…
dz: 大不列颠议会通过"茶叶法案",旨在通过减少其茶叶税并授予其直接向北美出售茶叶的权利来拯救英国东印度公司. 立法导致波士顿茶会.
de: The Parliament of Great Britain passes the Tea Act, designed to save the British East India Company by reducing taxes on its tea and granting it the right to sell tea directly to North America. The legislation leads to the Boston Tea Party.

te: Wolraad Woltemade rescues 14 sailors at the Cape of Good Hope from the sinking ship De Jonge Thomas by riding his horse…
dz: Wolraad Woltemade将14名水手从沉没的德琼克·托马斯号舰上救出,他们骑着他的马出海7次. 他和他的马,冯克, 都淹死在他的第八次尝试.
de: Wolraad Woltemade rescues 14 sailors at the Cape of Good Hope from the sinking ship De Jonge Thomas by riding his horse into the sea seven times. Both he and his horse, Vonk, are drowned on his eighth attempt.

de: American Revolution: Boston Tea Party: Members of the Sons of Liberty disguised as Mohawk Indians dump hundreds of crates of tea into Boston harbor as a protest against the Tea Act.

dz: 莫斯科国立舞蹈学院是凯瑟琳二世统治下成立的. 它是俄罗斯继瓦干诺瓦学院后第二所俄罗斯芭蕾舞学校.
